newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai central bank intervenes to defend baht.
newsitem.headline: Thai central bank intervenes to defend baht.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said on Wednesday it and the Monetary Authority of Singapore jointly intervened in the foreign exchange market to defend the baht.

The central bank said its action was "aimed at stemming excessive speculative activities which may lead to disorderly conditions in the Thai and regional financial markets". It said other appropriate measures will be taken as necessary.

Concerns over the health of the Thai economy, a slump in the stock market and speculation over a possible change in the Thai finance portfolio combined to batter the baht, driving it to 26.250-25.300 to the dollar on Wednesday morning, dealers said.
The central bank intervention, however, helped the currency recover to 26.030-26.080 shortly after lunch, they added.
